confidence_notes: Numbeo's Nuremberg price index (May 2026) anchors meals, cappuccino, and domestic draft beer. Cocktail and wine are estimated from their local price relationship to beer; accommodation is a holistic estimate and can rise around trade fairs and the Christmas market.
comparable_city_reasoning: No separate comparable city used; food and drink use Nuremberg-specific price observations, while accommodation reflects a bounded estimate for a mid-sized German visitor city.
